title: streamlined-oci-vendor-and-kubelet-bootstrap-for-isolated-sites
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private in highly restricted on-prem sites ran into two recurring pain points during air-gapped installation: 1) brittle vendor image set management across multiple distro variants (Ubuntu/RHEL/Alma/Rocky), and 2) long manual steps for pre-warming kubelets and local registry mirrors so nodes can join with minimal network access. This PR introduces a focused set of changes to improve offline bundle vendoring and automate kubelet bootstrapping for isolated sites.

What this PR does: 1) Add an OCI lockfile producer that emits a compact per-distro OCI index (images + digest pins + minimal platform hints) making vendored bundles smaller and easier to validate during apply. The index supports delta snapshots so airgap bundles can be shipped as incremental updates. 2) Add a small, idempotent kubelet-bootstrap script (systemd + unit template) which preloads CRI images from the local registry mirror and precreates required /var/lib/kubelet paths to reduce node bootstrap time in networks with high packet loss or proxy gateways. 3) Terraform module tweaks to the registry-mirror module: support for OCI-staging bucket configuration, atomic apply toggle (disable optimistic apply in strict-airgap), and improved IAM policy docs for on-prem object stores. 4) Helm chart change to allow imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent and to accept an ociIndex URL so charts can validate image digests before rendering. 5) Documentation and an example playbook for composing a minimal delta bundle and applying it to an offline cluster.

Backwards compatibility: Existing installer flows that use the previous monolithic lockfile continue to work; the new oci-index path is additive. If the installer finds an oci-index.json next to the bundle, it prefers the smaller delta-aware index.

Testing performed: Unit tests for the oci lockfile generator, integration test of delta snapshot apply using k3s in an isolated VM, manual bootstrap validation against Ubuntu 24 and Rocky 9 nodes, and terraform plan/apply smoke tests with a local minio backend. CI initially failed on lint (helm chart yamls); fixed chart values and re-ran.

Rollout plan: Release as part of the next private-installer minor (v0.46.x). Recommend early adoption in staging environments and a canary airgap rollout to two customer sites before recommending as default in docs.

Related: ENG-20248 (airgap bundle size reduction), ENG-21011 (kubelet bootstrap workstream).
commit_summary: 4 commits: 1) oci: add per-distro index generator and delta snapshot metadata (mthompson) 2) terraform/registry-mirror: add oci staging bucket and atomic_apply toggle (mthompson) 3) charts/redwood: support ociIndex and imagePullPolicy override (mthompson) 4) docs/scripts: kubelet-bootstrap + example delta bundle playbook and QA notes (mthompson)
review_thread:
Ethan Cole (reviewer): 'Nice incremental approach. Two main asks: make the oci-index schema forward-compatible and add a small validation error that surfaces digest mismatches early.'

Maya Thompson (author): 'Added schema version and compatibility markers (generator.go line 36). Also added verify_index.py which CI runs; will surface mismatches as non-zero exit codes.'

Priya Nair (reviewer): 'Terraform changes look good. Please document minimal perms for S3/minio and add an example ACE policy for on-prem object stores.'

Maya Thompson: 'Added README section with a sample policy; clarified atomic_apply semantics. Left a TODO for RBAC matrix to be filed as ENG-21400.'

Luca Romano (reviewer): 'kubelet-bootstrap script looks helpful, but please ensure it is idempotent on repeated runs and has clear failure modes for debugging.'

Maya Thompson: 'Script rewritten to be strictly idempotent, added --dry-run and verbose logging. Integration test added to smoke the path.'

Ethan Cole: 'Approving after minor nits addressed.'

Merge decision: Squash-and-merge after CI green and changelog entry.'

release_notes:
- Add OCI index producer to emit per-distro compact image lockfiles and delta snapshots for smaller airgap bundles.
- Add idempotent kubelet-bootstrap script and systemd unit to preload CRI images from a local registry mirror for faster, more reliable node join in restricted networks.
- Terraform: registry-mirror module gains oci staging bucket and atomic_apply toggle; docs for on-prem object store IAM/policy included.
- Helm chart: support ociIndex validation and imagePullPolicy override to make chart renders safer in air-gapped installs.
notes_for_ops: Operators should regenerate OCI index when images are rebased; use make_delta.sh to produce incremental updates. If using object stores with non-AWS S3 APIs, ensure registry-mirror.bucket_acl and minimal IAM policy from the README are applied. The kubelet-bootstrap tool is safe to run multiple times and provides --dry-run for preflight checks.
qa_checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for oci index generator
- [x] Integration delta apply in isolated VM
- [x] Terraform plan against local minio backend
- [x] Helm lint and chart render for airgap values

notes_for_security: No secrets are introduced in the repo. verify_index.py validates digests before ingest. Operators must still ensure object-store access keys are rotated and stored in the same secure KMS used for other deploy tooling.
